verdict.rationale: Yapily is an open banking API platform, so AI-generated insights over account data is a fair question. The evidence does not show it ships them. The closest item is transaction categorisation with merchant detection and 'spending insights', but nothing describes these as AI-generated or as in-product suggestions, so it is only an adjacent feature. The MCP, llms.txt and Agent Skills material connects coding agents to the documentation, not to the user's data.
